items.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers
items.statement: FY27 revenue target of about INR 56,000 crore excluding Vivo JV
items.speaker: Atul Lall

items.quote: without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%
items.statement: FY27 revenue growth of about 15-17% excluding Vivo
items.speaker: Atul Lall

items.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27.
items.statement: Telecom and networking revenue of INR 7,500-8,000 crore in FY27
items.speaker: Atul Lall

items.quote: we expect 3x growth in the revenues in the current fiscal against last year
items.statement: IT hardware revenue to grow 3x in FY27 (about INR 4,000 crore per later guidance)
items.speaker: Atul Lall

items.quote: we expect a higher double-digit teen growth in terms of volumes
items.statement: Mobile volume growth in the high teens in FY27
items.speaker: Saurabh Gupta

items.quote: there will be a margin expansion from last year's number by almost 40 bps, 50 bps
items.statement: EBITDA margin expansion of about 40-50 bps once component ramp is complete
items.speaker: Atul Lall

items.quote: As far as the absolute number is concerned, it will be in the similar range
items.statement: FY27 capex in a similar range to FY26 across display, IT and camera module capacity
items.speaker: Atul Lall

items.quote: we expect the operation to commence by Q2 this fiscal
items.statement: Noida 1 million sq ft facility to begin operations by Q2 FY27
items.speaker: Atul Lall

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management gives specific FY27 revenue, segment and volume targets and says the balance sheet can fund capex, though it declines to guide to a precise number for mobile volumes.
